answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can meter identity issuance at its wharf, the single onboarding pier where a new agent must escrow a small stake before receiving a berth. Each berth is capped one-per-hardware-attested-key, so an attacker flooding the ocean with fake identities pays real collateral for every hull. Idle lotus clones that never attest honest work slowly bleed a dormant-tax from their stake, while peers who counter-sign a caught impostor share the slashed funds, turning verification itself into paid work.
